facts.summary: Positive-framed Phase 1 ADC data (55% ORR) presented at ASCO, stock fell · Phase 1 · SIM0505 in gynecologic cancers · not yet approved
facts.indication: platinum-resistant ovarian cancer and uterine serous carcinoma (gynecologic cancers)

evidence.summary: NextCure Presents Positive SIM0505 Phase 1 Dose Escalation Data in Patients with Gynecologic Cancers at ASCO 2026
evidence.safety: Favorable safety and tolerability in heavily pretreated population supports ongoing Phase 1 dose-optimization with emphasis on PROC
evidence.program_discontinued: In May 2026, NextCure initiated a Phase 1 dose optimization segment in gynecologic cancers, initially focusing on patients with PROC.
